extName.message: Stellantis OAuth code for Home Assistant

extDescription.message: Shows the OAuth code after you log in to Peugeot, Citroën, DS, Opel or Vauxhall, ready to paste into Home Assistant.

pageIntro.message: You are logged in. Copy this code and paste it into Home Assistant.

pageNoCode.message: No code found. In Home Assistant, choose manual mode, open the login link shown there and log in; this page then opens by itself.

pageHint.message: Paste it in the “Stellantis Vehicles” setup, manual mode step. The code works only once and expires within minutes; if it fails, log in again.
